You will start your day on a scrum call to prioritize and track work. Within the team you work on, you will choose user stories to work within a sprint cycle. You will spend most of your day developing and testing your code. Every three weeks, you will be involved in the release activities.

As a Senior Lead Developer, you will work closely with your team to lead and guide projects to success. You'll have a hands-on role designing, developing, debugging, and deploying software solutions where you can leverage your expertise with code complexities. You'll also serve as a mentor to the junior developers. In the senior role, you will balance the assigning of user stories through prioritization and consideration of the technical interests of each developer on the team. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Pace should not scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

To thrive in this development career, you'll need to be an expert in:

  • Strong Java developer with REST API, spring and Spring-boot development experience;
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Experience writing SQLPL/SQL;
  • Golden Gate;
  • ETL Concepts;
  • Good understanding of Jenkins pipelines and CI/CD process;
  • Advanced English;

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to 90 stakeholders.

  • Build teams that thrive. As an experienced leader, you want everyone to shine. You'll start each day by checking in with your engineering team to identify priorities and challenges. You'll find a way to make the team's day go smoother. You are constantly looking for ways to share your knowledge, motivate others and keep everyone engaged and productive.
  • Build Products. You will use your technical expertise to review your team's work and help your people excel in an Agile environment. You're proactive and hands-on. When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.
  • Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could be checking in with a team in India one minute, meeting with leadership to review initiatives for the coming quarter later and tomorrow handling a few ad hoc requests from your peers in other departments.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.

Há ainda outros dois públicos atendidos: famílias carentes do entorno, que se beneficiam com as vendas dos Brechós mantidos pela Casa (em 2018 mais de 3.286 pessoas foram beneficiadas com produtos a preços populares) e famílias e mães (a maioria jovens mães solteiras) com enxoval para recém-nascidos e cesta básica.

Main responsibilities

O Gerente de Negócios (PJ) é responsável pela gestão e desenvolvimento da carteira de associados pessoa jurídica, oferecendo soluções financeiras do Sicredi alinhadas às necessidades desse público, promovendo uma melhor experiência aos associados e contribuindo para o crescimento da agência e da cooperativa.

Consultor financeiro:

Realizar estímulos aos associados com base nos dados da carteira, verificando a adequação das soluções financeiras às suas necessidades e apoiando suas decisões, criando estratégias financeiras que geram impacto positivo na comunidade.

Gestor de carteira de associados:

Administrar e desenvolver a carteira de associados, principalmente de Pessoa Jurídica, cumprindo metas comerciais, apresentando soluções financeiras adequadas e promovendo o alcance do planejamento estratégico.

Prospecção:

Buscar novos associados e negócios, conhecendo o ramo de atividade e o grau de endividamento, realizando visitas para ampliar o relacionamento e potencializar negócios.

Especialista digital:

Facilitar a interação dos associados com canais digitais, orientando sobre o uso de produtos e tecnologias disponíveis para agilidade e eficiência.

Atividades transacionais:

Controlar o endividamento da carteira, elaborar estratégias para resolução de inadimplência, realizar cadastros e atualizações de dados.

Integrador de novos associados:

title: Backend Software Engineer - Golang or Java
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.


With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

You will be joining a dynamic team at the forefront of developing and maintaining our Network API, xSIM Management System, and Recording Platforms. The Network API powers critical systems and services that enable the creation, configuration, and real-time monitoring of subscriber configurations across a wide array of business scenarios. These include enterprise solutions, IoT deployments, regulatory compliance, and recording services, ensuring seamless connectivity for everyone and everything. Our xSIM Management System is a high-performance, low-latency platform designed to handle hundreds of transactions per second, keeping all xSIMs accurately updated in real time. Meanwhile, our Recording Platforms deliver robust Mobile Compliance & Recording capabilities tailored for financial institutions, automatically capturing client and employee interactions either on-premises or through our secure cloud infrastructure.
We run a multi-site platform, following strict security requirements, provide the service to customers around the world and manage millions of subscriber profiles. We embrace a highly collaborative and diverse environment, value teamwork, autonomy and hold ourselves accountable for our deliverables and customer success.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide accurate effort estimates to support roadmap planning and effective expectation management.
  • Design and implement resilient, scalable, secure, and fault-tolerant architectures to ensure system reliability and performance.
  • Develop new features and support existing systems across the Network API, xSIM Management System, and Recording Platforms.
  • Contribute with small, incremental enhancements that seamlessly integrate into the established codebases.
  • Maintain and update existing solutions to keep them modern, efficient, and reliable.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth development processes and shared understanding.
  • Write and maintain comprehensive tests to ensure fast regression and reliable validation of new features.
  • Implement procedures and metrics to enable effective monitoring and observability of platform contributions.
  • Participate in code reviews to promote high standards of code quality, readability, and maintainability.
  • Take ownership of the quality and outcomes of your work, ensuring fully functional end-to-end flows.
  • Create and maintain accurate, up-to-date technical documentation.
  • Actively contribute to team discussions, with a mindset for continuous improvement and openness to new ideas or technologies.

Must Have

  • 3+ years of professional experience in backend development, preferably with Go (Golang). Strong Java experience with willing to learn Go is also welcome.
  • Strong understanding of concurrency models, with practical experience in implementing asynchronous workflows, inter-process communication, and synchronisation techniques.
  • Skilled in designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs, following best practices for API design and performance optimisation.
  • Proven experience working with databases, both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and non-relational (e.g., Redis, MongoDB, DynamoDB), including data modelling, query optimisation, and performance tuning.
  • Experienced in writing unit tests, integration tests, and benchmarks, with a test-driven development mindset.
  • Comfortable with networking protocols and distributed communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, WebSockets, TCP/UDP).
  • Experienced in building scalable microservices architectures and distributed systems.
  • Knowledgeable in applying software engineering best practices and design patterns for maintainable, testable code.
  • Skilled in using DevOps tools and practices, including Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Familiar with Git workflows and collaborative development processes such as pull requests, code reviews, and agile methodologies.
  • Demonstrated accountability for technical outcomes and ownership of end-to-end feature delivery.
  • Effective communicator in English, both written and verbal, suitable for a remote and largely asynchronous work environment.


Nice to Have

  • Proficient in writing idiomatic Go code, with solid understanding of the language’s core features such as interfaces, structs, composition, and error handling.
  • Competent in profiling and performance tuning using Go’s built-in tools such as pprof and trace, with a focus on optimisation.
  • Demonstrated experience with event-driven architectures, including the implementation of producers and consumers using platforms like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.
  • Solid hands-on experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining applications on Kubernetes.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud) with experience deploying cloud-native applications.
  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Job description

O DESAFIO QUE TE ESPERA

Gosta de um ambiente dinâmico? É proativo e gosta de "pôr a mão na massa"? Tem atitude de dono e vai pra cima dos problemas para resolvê-los É uma pessoa movida por desafios? Ama inovar e adora trabalhar em equipe?

A sua vontade de crescer conosco e fazer acontecer será a chave para seu sucesso por aqui! Vamos crescer juntos?


Main responsibilities

  • Apoio na apuração de Tributos: Calcular mensalmente o ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS ou IRPJ e CSLL das diferentes operações da empresa, observando a legislação vigente em cada estado e regime tributário aplicável.
  • Análise das Operações Fiscais: Revisar a escrituração fiscal executada pelos assistentes, observando a correta aplicação de CFOPs, NCMs, CSTs e alíquotas nos documentos fiscais emitidos e recebidos.
  • Conciliação Fiscal: Realizar a conciliação dos tributos apurados com os valores registrados na contabilidade, garantindo integridade das informações.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Preparar as declarações fiscais, como SPED Fiscal (ICMS/IPI), EFD-Contribuições (PIS/COFINS), GIA, DCTF, ECD, ECF e outras exigências estaduais e federais.
  • ICMS Substituição Tributária e DIFAL: Apurar as regras de substituição tributária e diferencial de alíquotas (DIFAL) nas operações interestaduais e de e-commerce.
  • Revisão de Créditos Tributários: Identificar créditos de ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS, garantindo correto aproveitamento conforme legislação e jurisprudência fiscal.
  • Análise das adições e exclusões da base de cálculo do IRPJ e CSLL.
  • Apoio em Fiscalizações e Auditorias: Fornecer suporte técnico e documental em fiscalizações, auditorias internas e externas, garantindo conformidade tributária.
  • Integração com Outras Áreas: Trabalhar em conjunto com contabilidade, compras, faturamento e jurídico para garantir a correta aplicação da legislação tributária e minimizar riscos fiscais.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Conhecimento básico de ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS ou IRPJ e CSLL.
  • Noções de obrigações acessórias e escrituração fiscal.
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP (SAP, TOTVS, Protheus ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em ERP (TOTVS, SAP, Protheus ou similares) e ferramentas fiscais.
  • Excel básico a intermediário.
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e interesse em aprender sobre a área tributária.

O que seria um UAU

  • Experiência prévia em atividades fiscais, mesmo que como estagiário.
  • Cursos ou especializações em tributação indireta, direta ou compliance fiscal.
  • Noções sobre operações de importação e comércio eletrônico.
  • Conhecimento em automação e transformação digital na área fiscal.

Additional information

title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate
description:
Our activities in Latin America are expanding and Medpace is seeking to add Experienced CRAs to our growing team in Brazil! The Clinical Research Associate at Medpace is offering the unique opportunity to have an exciting career in the research of drug and medical device development. For those with medical and/or health/life science interest and background who want to explore the research field, travel throughout Brazil , and be part of a team bringing pharmaceutical and medical devices to market - this could be the right opportunity for you!

Our successful Clinical Research Associates possess varied backgrounds in medical and other science-related healthcare fields.

PACE – MEDPACE CRA TRAINING PROGRAM

Medpace provides comprehensive initial and ongoing training, unmatched by other CROs. Through our PACE Training Program, you will join other P rofessionals A chieving C RA E xcellence:

  • PACE provides the platform to effectively and confidently carry out your duties, enhance your current abilities and ultimately help you become a high-functioning independent Medpace CRA.
  • PACE will prepare you by developing your CRA skills through interactive discussions and hands-on job-related exercises and practicums.
  • To supplement your in-house and field-based training you may also participate in other clinical research departmental core rotations, learning other aspects of the drug/device development and approval process.

UNEXPECTED REWARDS

This role will allow you to make a difference on a large scale through the enhancement of pharmaceuticals and medical devices. The CRA position provides many other distinctive advantages including:

  • Dynamic working environment, with varying responsibilities day-to-day;
  • Expansive experience in multiple therapeutic areas;
  • Work within a team of therapeutic and regulatory experts;
  • Defined CRA promotion and growth ladder with potential for mentoring and management advancements;
  • Competitive pay and opportunity for significant travel bonus.

Responsibilities
  • Conduct qualification, initiation, monitoring, and closeout visits for research sites in compliance with the approved protocol;
  • Communication with the medical site staff including coordinators, clinical research physicians and their site staff;
  • Verifying adequate investigator qualifications, training and resources, including facilities, laboratories, equipment, and staff;
  • Medical record and research source documentation verification against case report form data, including informing the site staff of any entry errors, ensuring good documentation practices are being adhered to and communicating protocol deviations appropriately per SOPs, GCP and applicable regulatory requirements;
  • Verification that the investigator is enrolling only eligible subjects;
  • Regulatory document review;
  • Investigational product/drug accountability and inventory;
  • Verification and review of adverse events, serious adverse events, concomitant medications and corresponding illnesses to confirm accurate data reporting in accordance with the protocol;
  • Assessing the clinical research site’s patient recruitment and retention success and offering suggestions for improvement;
  • Completion of monitoring reports and follow-up letters, which includes providing summaries of the significant findings, deviations, deficiencies, and recommended actions to secure compliance.

Qualifications

***We kindly ask that you submit your application in English***

  • Bachelor's degree in a health or science-related field is required;
  • 2-5 years of experience in clinical monitoring preferred;
  • Proven track record of demonstrating experience in clinical patient management, protocol, CRF, preparing of ISF and reconciling TMF documentation;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of a team dedicated to supporting the development of ground-breaking drugs and devices. Our employees provide hope for those living with debilitating diseases. We invite you to be a part of something that is impacting millions of people around the globe while enjoying a competitive total compensation and benefits package and internal growth opportunities.

Organic Growth: Medpace is continuing to grow in all areas globally and has built an expansive research campus at its headquarters in Cincinnati, OH. In 2020, Medpace opened a new seven-story building that is approximately 250,000 SQFT. In total, the headquarters campus includes five buildings and approximately 600,000 SQFT. The company also has expanding office locations in Dallas, TX and Denver, CO.

  • On-site fitness center(s);
  • Campus walking paths;
  • Company-sponsored social and wellness events;
  • Official Sponsor of FC Cincinnati;
  • Hybrid work-from-home options and flexible work schedule;
  • On-site Market Place;
  • Free and covered parking;
  • Discounts for local businesses;
  • On-campus restaurants and banks coming soon.

Awards:

  • Medpace historically named a Top Cincinnati Workplace by the Cincinnati Enquirer;
  • Recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Mid-size Companies in 2021;
  • Medpace ranks amongst top CROs for site ratings across all 10 important attributes including CRA training, preparation & organization, accessibility of staff, open communication, and ensuring timely drug availability;
  • Continually recognized with CRO Leadership Awards from Life Science Leader magazine based on expertise, quality, capabilities, reliability, and compatibility;
  • Ranked in the top 10 on the 2021 LinkedIn Top Companies list in Cincinnati.

title: Manager, Commercial Planning
description:
Why PlayStation?

PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation5, PlayStation4, PlayStationVR, PlayStationPlus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.

PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.

The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

Manager, Commercial Planning

S ao Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

The Manager, Commercial Planning will support demand forecasting across all PlayStation Categories (Hardware, Software and Peripherals) for the Latin America Region. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams across Global, Americas, and local Latin American markets to contribute to a robust, consensus based demand plan. This position plays an important role in aligning demand with supply, improving forecast accuracy, supporting new product introductions, and driving S&OP processes to ensure operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

You will have an opportunity to apply your business acumen, analytical mindset and organizational skills to help scale a growing regional business.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, PlayStation LATAM, this role supports key planning activities and offers visibility into strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and coach a regional commercial planning team, fostering collaboration, development, and performance excellence.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of short- and long-term demand forecasts at product, category, and channel levels, using historical data, market trends, and promotional inputs.
  • Support the S&OP process by working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure alignment and accuracy.
  • Act as a key liaison between regional sales teams, marketing, and operations to maintain coordinated and well-informed demand plans.
  • Assist in building the yearly budget, quarterly forecast and monthly flash sales plans and follow its performance, reporting and explain variances.
  • Support executive-level reporting and presentations with accurate and insightful forecasting data.
  • Engage with channel teams to collaborate on forecasting and obtain and ensure that current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts.
  • Monitor assumptions, risks, and opportunities impacting the demand plan, and communicate implications as needed.
  • Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate results.
  • Coordinate with Global and Americas planning teams to communicate market requirements and updates.
  • Support Sales, MKT and Head of Sales on ad-hoc analysis to run the business. Manage day to day sales and planning operation.
  • Improve data quality by ongoing validation & follow up of sell-out and sell-through.
  • Understand new product introduction roadmaps to manage product transitions.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Operations or Sales Planning.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Engineering or related field.
  • Past experience directly managing and developing a team while delivering strong business outcomes.
  • Solid understanding of forecasting processes, S&OP, and commercial planning.
  • Familiarity with planning tools such as SAP/IBP.
  • Highly analytical, data-driven decision maker with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to interpret complex data sets (both qualitative and quantitative) and present findings clearly and effectively.
  • Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Enthusiastic and confident team player with excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to connect and collaborate effectively across diverse teams. Brings an innovative mindset and learns quickly in dynamic environments.
  • Clear and concise written skills. Ability to concept, write and develop persuasive, organized presentations.
  • High level of organization and flexibility to deal with urgent requests.
  • Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Bilingual in English is a must (Spanish is a plus).

Please apply with a resume in English

  • Experience using and creating containers and virtual machines
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree (or any higher) or equivalent professional experience (5+ years of professional experience)
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. title: Finance Manager - Accounting & Tax
description:
Tax & Accounting Manager - Telecommunications

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

The Tax & Accounting Manager role sits within the Financial Control team, reporting directly to the Head of Treasury, Risk and Compliance, and is based out of our São Paulo, Brazil office. The primary focus will be on Brazilian financial management, including accounting, tax compliance, and regulatory financial reporting for our MVNO operations in Brazil. The role will oversee financial operations for our registrations in both São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. As 1GLOBAL expands its MVNO operations in the Brazilian market, this role offers exposure to a wide range of financial areas—accounting, tax compliance, regulatory reporting, and financial planning—within the complex Brazilian telecommunications regulatory environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional with telecommunications experience looking to develop in a fast-growing, multinational environment with diverse and evolving financial and regulatory challenges.

The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Manage all accounting operations for 1GLOBAL's Brazilian entities, ensuring compliance with Brazilian accounting standards (including CPC/IFRS) and practices.
  • Prepare financial statements for Brazilian operations in accordance with local requirements.
  • Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment with group reporting and audit requirements.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors for Brazilian operations, including statutory audits.

Tax Compliance & Filing

  • Prepare and file all federal tax returns (including IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS), state tax returns (ICMS), and municipal tax returns (ISS) in Brazil.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of ancillary tax obligations such as ECD, ECF, EFD-ICMS/IPI, EFD-Contribuições, SPED, and DIRF.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian transfer pricing rules for intercompany transactions.
  • Stay current with Brazilian tax legislation changes and ensure company compliance, particularly with telecommunications-specific tax regulations.

Regulatory Financial Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with Anatel financial reporting requirements for MVNOs, including periodic financial submissions.
  • Oversee payment and management of TFI (Installation Inspection Fee) and TFF (Operation Inspection Fee) for activated devices.
  • Ensure proper financial record-keeping for regulatory audits and inspections.
  • Coordinate with legal and regulatory teams on financial aspects of telecommunications compliance.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • Professional accounting qualification (e.g., CRC - Conselho Regional de Contabilidade).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in financial roles in Brazil.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian accounting standards and tax regulations.
  • Experience managing tax registrations and compliance across multiple Brazilian jurisdictions, specifically São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro.
  • Proven experience with Brazilian tax reporting systems including SPED (Sistema Público de Escrituração Digital).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with mobile network operators or other telecommunications service providers in Brazil.
  • Experience with Brazilian telecommunications taxation specifics, including FUST and FUNTEL contributions.
  • Knowledge of NetSuite and Vertex.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Nossos valores

  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

>> Sobre a vaga

Essa oportunidade é para a área de RH Operações, dentro da célula de melhoria de processos, que tem a missão de realizar a análise dos processos existentes buscando pontos de melhoria que necessitam ser aplicados, seja eles processuais ou sistêmicos, visando a jornada E2E do processo e atuação na causa raiz de um possível problema.

Além disso, você irá também realizar o desenvolvimento de um roadmap de implementação e acompanhamento da evolução das ações, através de processos estabelecidos, análise de resultados e identificação de novas oportunidades de aprimoramento e atuação como referência técnica ao time, visando a entrega contínua de valor ao cliente.

Esse é um time apaixonado por desafios, melhorias e processos; você pode se dar muito bem se gostar de buscar soluções inovadoras, identificando novas oportunidades de crescimento.

>> Principais responsabilidades:

  • Proposição de Solução: viabilizar proposta de solução para o levantamento de necessidades, envolvendo visão de processo e/ou sistema;
  • Melhorias de Processos: realizar o processo de melhoria contínua da operação, através de levantamento de necessidades e desdobramento de indicadores;
  • Documentação: garantir a documentação do processo atual como fluxo AS IS, matriz RACI, regras, integrações sistêmicas;
  • Monitoramento de Resultados: apoiar na definição de métricas da operação, através de reuniões de alinhamento, visando entender as necessidades para acompanhamento dos processos;
  • Implementação: estruturação de roadmap e plano com requisitos e atividades para implementação dos ajustes de processos e de sistemas, incluindo prazos e responsáveis;
  • Avaliação de Riscos: realizar a avaliação de riscos dos processos, através de alinhamento com as áreas responsáveis, apoiar em simulações e analisar dados, visando entender a efetividade da melhoria proposta do processo.

>> Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Residir em São Paulo ou disponibilidade para mudança;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Metodologia Lean Manufacturing;
  • Six Sigma;
  • Power Point;
  • Belt.

>> Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir conhecimento com PDCA;
  • Conhecer sobre Kaizen, técnicas de priorização e experiência com o cliente;
  • Conhecimento avançado com Bizage;
  • Capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Análise crítica;
  • Senso investigativo;
  • Criatividade;
  • Disposição para ensinar;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Capacidade de mobilizar equipes para participação e contribuição nos projetos/processos direcionados a metas e resultados.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: PHP Laravel API Developer

Join the Team Redefining How Documents Are Signed!

At SignerX , we’re not just building software—we’re transforming moments into experiences. From patent-pending personalized video greetings to branded celebration games and conversational forms, our Signer eXperience platform is revolutionizing the document-signing process. And guess what? We’re looking for YOU to join our nimble, EOS-driven team as a PHP Laravel API Developer !

Building on 11+ years of success with our groundbreaking product WP E-Signature—trusted by PayPal, the NBA, and more, with millions of documents signed—SignerX is a bold new platform reimagined by top UI/UX talent from Atlassian, ActiveCampaign, and HelpScout.

This is your chance to collaborate with a passionate, creative, and fun-loving group of innovators, all working together to change an industry forever.

Why You’ll Love It Here

When we say you matter at SignerX, we mean it. Here’s what you can expect from our team culture:

Creative Autonomy: Your ideas aren’t just welcome—they’re celebrated. If you see a better way to solve a problem or a unique feature to add, we’re all ears.

Supportive Team Dynamics: At SignerX, there’s no red tape or ego battles—just smart, passionate people working together to build something amazing.

Celebrate the Wins: Big or small, every success is celebrated. Expect kudos, confetti (yes, literally), and a culture that uplifts and energizes.

Work-Life Balance: We know you’re human. We value sustainable work hours, flexibility, and fostering an environment where you can thrive both personally and professionally.

Impact-Driven Work: Everything you create here will directly contribute to helping businesses grow and connect with their customers in meaningful ways.

We give you the freedom to work your way while ensuring the tools, support, and team dynamics are here to help you succeed.

What You’ll Work On

As our PHP Laravel Developer, you’ll be part of the magic. Here’s how:

  • Collaborate with a small but mighty team to create features that delight users and wow our customers.
  • Build APIs, webhooks, and integrations that feel as intuitive as they are innovative.
  • Push boundaries with clean, scalable code that prioritizes quality and performance.
  • Solve meaningful problems, crush bugs, and deliver features that turn heads.
  • Be a key player in turning our product roadmap into reality, one transformative feature at a time.
  • Building out and maintaining third-party partnerships (Zapier, Quickbooks, Sales Force, etc).
  • Meeting at minimum, twice a week with the core development team.
  • Daily slack standups/check-ins/updates.

Our Tech Stack

We love modern tools that make life easier (and more fun):

  • BACKEND: PHP, Laravel & JSON.
  • CLOUD: Cloudways/Digital Ocean, Wasabi/AWS storage.
  • PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Trello, Slack, G-suite.

What You Bring to the Team

We’re looking for someone who’s as passionate about people and innovation as they are about writing great code. Some of the skills we’d love to see:

  • 4+ years of PHP Laravel development experience.
  • Strong experience with building, maintaining, and documenting RESTful APIs for growing user bases.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL databases, queries, and optimization.
  • Familiarity with React.js is a plus but not required.
  • Experience in customer-facing SaaS environments is a major bonus.
  • Proven ability to pick up an existing API, enhance its features, and scale it to support growing usage.
  • A commitment to testing and QA: You understand that self-testing your work is critical. You take pride in delivering code that works seamlessly, doesn’t break the app, and respects the integrity of existing features.
  • The ability to collaborate, communicate, and lead initiatives in a dynamic, creative environment.
  • Bonus if you have experience with video streaming.

Above all, we’re looking for a teammate who cares deeply about their craft and is ready to help us take SignerX to new heights.

Why This Role Is for Senior Developers

This isn’t a junior or mid-level position. We need a senior developer who:

  • Can hit the ground running with an established codebase and API.
  • Brings a wealth of experience and knowledge to the table, not just in writing code but in shaping systems, processes, and features.
  • Understands the importance of testing and self-QA to deliver reliable, high-quality code that’s scalable and maintainable.
  • Thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where leadership, initiative, and ownership of work are highly valued.

What We’re Looking For

We’re seeking an individual contractor who is ready to bring their skills, passion, and expertise directly to the team. This role is for someone who loves taking ownership of their work and collaborating closely with our developers to create amazing results.

What This Role Isn’t

This is not a role for agencies or teams, and you can’t outsource your work or delegate tasks to others. We value direct communication, accountability, and the unique perspective you bring to the table.

Ready to Make Magic Happen?

At SignerX, we’re redefining what it means to work in tech. We’re not just creating software—we’re creating joyful, meaningful experiences that people remember.

If this sounds like your dream job, apply today and join a team that’s as passionate about people as it is about code.

Let’s celebrate you, your talents, and everything we’ll create together at SignerX.

description:
São Paulo - SP

ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS

  1. Executar os procedimentos privativos e relacionados a práticas avançadas de enfermagem, através das diretrizes do modelo assistencial para garantir as melhores práticas institucionais.
  2. Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações baseado nos protocolos institucionais na busca da prevenção e controle sistemático de danos a pacientes durante a assistência de saúde através do cumprimento das metas de segurança do paciente e, ao término do plantão informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional.
  3. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  4. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura.
  5. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, dos treinamentos e eventos pertinentes, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares.
  6. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes no HSC.
  7. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas e contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador realizando acompanhamento e treinamento dos colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício de mesma função assistencial.
  8. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais.
  9. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada.
  10. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.
  11. Contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação e na elaboração e implementação de manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares.
  12. Encaminhar os pacientes para o centro cirúrgico, checando o pré-operatório de acordo com o diagnóstico do paciente por meio de ferramenta sistematizada (SAEP- Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Peri operatória) para garantir a segurança de acordo com as metas internacionais.
  13. Promover e difundir medidas de prevenção de riscos e agravos por meio da educação paciente e familiares, objetivando melhorar a qualidade de vida do paciente.

INSTITUIÇÃO

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida.

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES: Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Realizar com precisão e qualidade a soldagem de flanges em tubos de ferro fundido, seguindo as especificações técnicas e normas de segurança da Mult Hidro, contribuindo para a produção de componentes hidráulicos de alta qualidade.

CONHECIMENTO

  • Técnicas avançadas de soldagem em ferro fundido (solda MIG).
  • Propriedades e características do ferro fundido.
  • Normas de segurança e procedimentos específicos para soldagem de flanges.
  • Conhecimento de metalurgia relacionada ao ferro fundido.

HABILIDADES

  • Alta precisão na execução de soldas em flanges.
  • Habilidade para manter alinhamento e posicionamento corretos.
  • Capacidade de ajustar parâmetros de soldagem para otimizar resultados.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e controle de qualidade.
  • Resolução de problemas relacionados à soldagem de ferro fundido.

ATITUDE

  • Comprometimento com a qualidade e precisão das soldas.
  • Proatividade na identificação de melhorias no processo.
  • Disposição para aprendizado contínuo em técnicas de soldagem especializadas.
  • Responsabilidade no manuseio de materiais e equipamentos.
  • Colaboração efetiva com a equipe de produção.

VALORES DA EMPRESA

  • INTEGRIDADE
  • RESPONSABILIDADE
  • PRODUTIVIDADE
  • CONTRIBUIÇÃO
  • RESULTADO

VALORES DO CARGO

  • Excelência técnica em soldagem especializada.
  • Compromisso com a qualidade do produto final.
  • Eficiência operacional.
  • Melhoria contínua dos processos de soldagem.

ENTREGA

  • Soldas de alta qualidade e precisão em flanges de ferro fundido.
  • Cumprimento dos prazos de produção e metas de qualidade.
  • Redução de retrabalho e desperdício de materiais.
  • Contribuição para a melhoria contínua dos processos de soldagem.
  • Conformidade com normas de segurança e especificações técnicas.

OBSERVAÇÕES NECESSÁRIAS

  • O cargo requer atenção constante e precisão devido à natureza crítica da soldagem de flanges.
  • É importante manter-se atualizado sobre técnicas específicas de soldagem para ferro fundido e flanges.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATIVIDADES

  1. Executar soldagens especializadas de flanges em tubos de ferro fundido.
  2. Interpretar desenhos técnicos e especificações relacionadas à soldagem de flanges.
  3. Preparar tubos e flanges para soldagem, incluindo limpeza, alinhamento e posicionamento.
  4. Selecionar e configurar equipamentos de soldagem apropriados para ferro fundido.
  5. Realizar inspeções visuais e testes para garantir a qualidade e estanqueidade das soldas.
  6. Operar e manter equipamentos de soldagem em ótimas condições.
  7. Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança e utilizar equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs).
  8. Realizar controle de qualidade das peças soldadas, garantindo a conformidade com as especificações.
  9. Colaborar com a equipe de produção para otimizar o processo de soldagem de flanges.
  10. Registrar detalhadamente as atividades realizadas, incluindo parâmetros de soldagem e materiais utilizados.
  11. Manter a área de trabalho organizada e limpa, garantindo a eficiência do processo.
  12. Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas específicas para soldagem em ferro fundido.
  13. Realizar outras atividades conforme a solicitação de sua chefia inerente à função.
  14. Cuidar e solicitar manutenção dos equipamentos de sua responsabilidade.

Sobre a Golfleet

Em 2007 nasceu a GolSat, especialista em tecnologia para gestão de frotas leves.

Em 15 anos de história, criamos soluções pioneiras no mercado de frotas leves, e evoluímos tanto, que nosso software abraçou nossa empresa: GolSat agora é Golfleet! Estamos de cara nova, desafios novos, mas pautados nos mesmos valores, no mesmo propósito: preservar vidas, todos os dias.

Se você se identificou, venha conhecer um pouco mais sobre nós.

Se há algo profundamente registrado em nosso DNA, desde o nosso nascimento, é a compreensão de que não adianta falar sobre tecnologia e propósito se a gente não entender que a grande força transformadora vem das pessoas.

Foi assim há mais de 10 anos, quando chegamos no mercado com um software pioneiro que valorizava o papel do gestor de frotas e contribuía para que ele atuasse com foco na sustentabilidade: mais economia, menos acidentes e mais cuidado com o meio ambiente. E continua assim agora, em um cenário onde a mobilidade está transformando o novo mundo, nos fazendo buscar a maneira mais eficaz, inteligente e humana de otimizar o dia a dia de quem precisa se deslocar no mundo corporativo.

Nossa sede física fica em Londrina no Paraná, porém adotamos o trabalho remoto/híbrido e temos um time espalhado por todo o Brasil, são aproximadamente 150 pessoas atuando diretamente na Golfleet, atendendo todos os clientes com paixão e brilho nos olhos, e trabalhando com muito empenho para proporcionar soluções eficientes, principalmente, ajudar a transformar o mundo com inovação, tecnologia, criatividade e sustentabilidade.

Na Golfleet a Missão, Visão e Valores não são meras formalidades, mas sim um norte para decisões no dia a dia:

MISSÃO: Desenvolver inovações consistentes, entregando tecnologia de ponta, para uma gestão de frotas sempre produtiva, humana e segura.

VISÃO: Consolidar-se como referência mundial em tecnologias que preservam vidas e geram economia inteligente para frotas.

  • Ambiente acolhedor.
  • Atitudes criativas.
  • Respeito sempre.

Sobre o time

O Comercial Corporate trabalha focado em implantar as soluções Golfleet em grandes frotas, e consequentemente salvar mais vidas. A missão do time é mostrar para os gestores de frotas que ainda não são nossos clientes, o quanto nossa tecnologia pode impactar no seu negócio, ajudando a trabalhar a otimização de recursos e a sustentabilidade em suas empresas.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) to build high-performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. From Ubuntu One SSO to Juju, LXD and MAAS your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications.
This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. You will work with upstream open source projects, alongside internal teams to deliver high quality software that can be deployed on bare metal, public cloud and Kubernetes.
As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.
You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.
In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Proven experience hiring and leading a high performance software engineering team
  • Experience with Go and Python software development
  • Ability to design and implement complex, distributed system
  • Experience working with container technology and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of software/infrastructure security and performance
  • Experience designing and/or operating large scale distributed systems
  • Knowledge of identity and access management technologies and standards is desirable but not essential
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Early Findings: CBD Promotes Tooth Biomineralization
description:
Early Findings: CBD Promotes Tooth Biomineralization

A new study suggests that cannabidiol (CBD) can trigger biomineralization of teeth under inflammatory conditions, thus promoting tissue repair. The research, published in the Journal of Dentistry , may have implications for future dental therapies.

Previous studies have found that CBD exhibits anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties when put in contact with dental pulp stem cells. In vitro research also suggests that the compound may have osteogenic and odontogenic effects. With this in mind, the researchers behind the current study investigated the effects of CBD on dental pulp cells under pro-inflammatory stimuli.

To do so, they exposed cells from the dental pulp of mice to a cytokine called tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), implicated in both inflammatory and autoimmune processes. They then treated the cells with varying CBD concentrations for periods spanning 24 hours to seven days.

“The ability of the cells to survive and function in this environment was evaluated, which allowed us to determine if the substance has any bioactive effect on them,” said study author Francisco Wanderley Garcia de Paula-Silva, professor in the Department of Pediatrics at the University of São Paulo, Brazil, in a press release.

The researchers also studied the formation of mineralization nodules and assessed the effect of CBD in modulating the synthesis of inflammatory mediators by macrophages.

Ultimately, they found that CBD stimulated the capacity for tooth biomineralization and inhibited the synthesis of inflammatory mediators, pointing towards an anti-inflammatory effect.

“These findings indicate that cannabidiol may be a promising bioactive substance for tissue repair in inflammatory contexts, which opens up new perspectives for its use in dental treatments, especially in regenerative dentistry, benefiting patients in different clinical situations,” said Paula-Silva.

“The growing interest in cannabinoid-based therapies, coupled with a deeper understanding of cannabidiol’s mechanisms of action, may facilitate future clinical trials, especially as more data become available,” he added.

Sources: EurekAlert, Journal of Dentistry

We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.
We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.
To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.
Location: Globally remote role
The role entails
Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.

  • Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
  • Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
  • Python software development expertise
  • Operational experience

  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards

  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer to help design, manage, and automate our private cloud infrastructure . This role requires deep expertise in on-premises infrastructure —including physical servers, storage, virtualization (VMware & other hypervisors), and networking —combined with a strong DevOps mindset and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) approach . You will play a key role in modernizing infrastructure operations using GitOps methodologies , ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and fully automated .

We are open to hiring for this position in Lisbon, Portugal, and São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Private Cloud Management : Oversee and optimize on-premises infrastructure , including VMware and other hypervisors, physical servers, and storage solutions .
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) : Implement and enforce GitOps workflows , automating provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Ansible, and other IaC tools .
  • Virtualization & Compute : Manage and optimize virtualization environments (VMware vSphere, ESXi, KVM, etc. ).
  • Storage & Networking : Design and manage storage solutions (SAN, NAS, SDS) and work with networking components (VLANs, Load Balancers, DNS, etc.) .
  • Automation & CI/CD : Develop and maintain automation for infrastructure deployment, monitoring, and maintenance via GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, and configuration management .
  • Observability & Monitoring : Ensure system reliability through Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar monitoring solutions .
  • Security & Compliance : Implement security best practices, including IAM, role-based access control (RBAC), system hardening, and compliance with industry standards .
  • Collaboration & Documentation : Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve infrastructure scalability, reliability, and automation processes .

Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in infrastructure engineering, with expertise in building, deploying, and managing global infrastructure systems.
  • Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge of Red Hat Linux/Rocky Linux (or similar) and Linux system administration.
  • Virtualisation: Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi for managing virtualised environments (installation, configuration, troubleshooting).
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficient in Terraform, Ansible, Packer, and Puppet for automating infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • HCI (Hyper-Converged Infrastructure): Experience designing, deploying, and managing HCI solutions.
  • Kubernetes & Containerisation: Expertise in Kubernetes, Helm, and service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio) for container orchestration.
  • Networking: Deep understanding of high-performance networking, SR-IOV, NFV, and networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS).
  • System Architecture: Knowledge of hardware concepts (disk subsystems, memory, CPU, NICs, RAID, I/O subsystems, HBA, iSCSI, Fiber Channel, Ethernet) and performance optimisation.
  • Security & Compliance: Experience with system hardening, compliance frameworks (CIS, GDPR), and IAM systems (OpenLDAP, Active Directory, PAM).
  • Monitoring & Observability: Expertise in tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, and Loki for system monitoring and proactive issue resolution.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Familiar with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and contributing to infrastructure automation.
  • Scripting & Programming: Proficient in Python, Bash, or Go for infrastructure management and automation.
  • Storage Technologies: Familiar with SDS (Software Defined Storage) and data protection strategies (backup, disaster recovery).
  • Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to resolve infrastructure issues under pressure.
  • Continuous Learning: Passionate about staying up-to-date with the latest technologies and best practices in infrastructure.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Atuar em parceria com diferentes departamentos da companhia como comercial de originação, logística, data science, trading, entre outros;
  2. Utilizar dados proprietários, dados e insights obtidos através de pesquisa com fontes externas e análise dos principais indicadores do setor de commodities agrícolas local e global, para atuar na construção dos balanços de oferta e demanda de soja, milho, algodão;
  3. Realizar estimativas de demanda interna de soja para crushing, milho, farelo e substitutos (como DDG’s) para ração animal, demanda de óleo no mercado doméstico (biodiesel, óleo envasado) a nível de estado;
  4. Realizar cruzamento de informações como produção agrícola, farmer selling e demanda, para auxiliar nas discussões de ownership do mercado;
  5. Criar e manter processos de modelagem de dados, incluindo elaboração de documentação de novos processos;
  6. Preparar análises setoriais e relatórios executivos, comunicar de forma efetiva potenciais desbalanços e insights obtidos de análises para todos os stakeholders da área, incluindo apresentações em inglês.

Qualificações

  1. Conhecimento dos processos de construção, manutenção e análise de balanços de oferta e demanda de soja, milho, algodão, trigo e subprodutos (farelo, óleo);
  2. Conhecimento sobre as principais variáveis que influenciam o mercado de commodities agrícolas (foco em soja, milho e algodão) para projeções de crushing, demanda doméstica de proteínas, fluxos logísticos e farmer selling;
  3. Conhecimento de técnicas estatísticas básicas para análise de dados e aplicação de métodos quantitativos na projeção das variáveis mencionadas, além de gestão e manipulação de diferentes bases de dados, internas e externas;
  4. Conhecimento sobre as principais variáveis que influenciam a formação da produção agrícola das principais commodities no Brasil e no mundo (foco soja, milho, trigo, algodão);
  5. Conhecimento de técnicas de análise exploratória de dados para análise descritiva, métodos estatísticos (regressão linear), análise de medidas de dispersão, entre outros;
  6. Desejável conhecimento de linguagem de programação, como Python e/ou R (Posit) como foco em pacotes como SciPy, Statsmodels, Numpy, Pandas, para alavancar a aplicação dessas técnicas estatísticas, além de Matplotlib e outros pacotes para visualização de dados;
  7. Excel (avançado para o uso de fórmulas, condições lógicas, manipulação de dados).
  8. Inglês avançado.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.
